cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This policy describes the use of cookies and similar technologies on the Pistakio Gelato website.
cookiePolicy.whatAreCookiesText: Cookies are small text files or similar technologies that may be stored on the user's device while browsing. They may be used to ensure the proper functioning of a website, remember certain preferences or, in some cases, analyse browsing activity and create profiles.
cookiePolicy.cookiesUsedText: The Pistakio website does not directly use its own cookies for profiling or personalised advertising. The main application features primarily use the browser's localStorage.
cookiePolicy.noProfilingText: Based on the current configuration of the website, proprietary cookies are not used for profiling, personalised advertising or remarketing purposes.
cookiePolicy.technicalText: The application uses the browser's localStorage to store certain information necessary for the operation of the service. This information does not constitute cookies.
cookiePolicy.authStorage: Storage of the token required to manage user authentication.
cookiePolicy.languageStorage: Storage of the language selected by the user.
cookiePolicy.paymentText: During the payment process, the website may redirect the user to payment services provided by third parties. These services may use cookies and similar technologies on their own domains.
cookiePolicy.stripeText: Stripe may use cookies and similar technologies during the payment process to operate the service, secure transactions and prevent fraud.
cookiePolicy.paypalText: PayPal may use cookies and similar technologies during the payment process to operate the service, secure transactions and prevent fraud.
cookiePolicy.thirdPartyText: Third-party services may use their own storage or tracking technologies when users interact with their services. These technologies are governed by the policies of the respective providers.
cookiePolicy.managementText: Users can manage or delete information stored by their browser through their browser settings. Disabling certain necessary technologies may affect the proper functioning of some website features.
cookiePolicy.durationText: The duration of stored information depends on the specific technology and the purpose for which it is used. For third-party services, retention periods are determined by the respective providers.
cookiePolicy.updatesText: This Cookie Policy may be updated if there are changes to the technologies used, the services offered or the applicable legislation. The updated version will be published on this page.
cookiePolicy.contactText: For information about the use of cookies and similar technologies, you can contact the data controller using the details below.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy describes how Pistakio Gelato processes the personal data of users who use the website and its related services.
privacyPolicy.controllerText: The data controller responsible for processing personal data is the entity indicated below.
privacyPolicy.dataIntro: In connection with the use of the website, the following categories of personal data may be processed:
privacyPolicy.dataContact: email address and other contact details provided by the user
privacyPolicy.dataOrder: information relating to orders, purchased products and deliveries
privacyPolicy.dataAccount: data required to manage the account and user authentication
privacyPolicy.dataTechnical: technical data necessary for the operation and security of the service
privacyPolicy.purposeIntro: Personal data may be processed for the following purposes:
privacyPolicy.purposeAccountText: Creation and management of the account, user authentication and access to restricted features.
privacyPolicy.purposeOrdersText: Receiving, managing and processing orders placed through the website and providing related assistance.
privacyPolicy.purposePaymentText: Management of payments and related security and fraud prevention activities through the available payment providers.
privacyPolicy.purposeShippingText: Management of order preparation and delivery to the address provided by the user.
privacyPolicy.purposeSupportText: Management of requests submitted by the user and necessary communications relating to services and orders.
privacyPolicy.purposeLegalText: Compliance with applicable legal obligations, including administrative, tax and accounting requirements.
privacyPolicy.legalBasisIntro: Personal data is processed on the basis of the lawful conditions provided for by applicable legislation.
privacyPolicy.basisContract: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures requested by the user
privacyPolicy.basisLegitimateInterest: Legitimate interest of the data controller
privacyPolicy.provisionText: Providing the data necessary to create an account, manage orders, arrange delivery and process payments is necessary to provide the relevant services. Failure to provide the required data may prevent the requested service from being provided.
privacyPolicy.recipientsIntro: Personal data may be disclosed, to the extent necessary for the relevant purposes, to the following parties:
privacyPolicy.recipientTechnical: technical service providers necessary for the operation and security of the website
privacyPolicy.recipientsNote: Parties processing data on behalf of the data controller may be appointed as data processors where required by applicable legislation.
privacyPolicy.paymentText: The website uses third-party services to process payments. Data required for payment may be processed directly by the relevant providers in accordance with their respective privacy policies.
privacyPolicy.stripeText: Stripe processes the data necessary to manage payments and related activities concerning transaction security and fraud prevention.
privacyPolicy.paypalText: PayPal processes the data necessary to manage payments and related activities concerning transaction security and fraud prevention.
privacyPolicy.securityText: The data controller adopts appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, unlawful use, unauthorised access, alteration or unauthorised disclosure.
privacyPolicy.retentionText: Personal data is retained for no longer than necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, subject to any legal obligations or requirements for the protection of the data controller's rights.
privacyPolicy.retentionAccountText: Retained for as long as the account remains active, subject to any additional retention requirements provided by law.
privacyPolicy.retentionOrdersText: Retained for the period necessary to manage the order and subsequently for any periods required by administrative, tax and accounting legislation.
privacyPolicy.retentionMessagesText: Retained for the period necessary to manage the request and for the time required to protect the data controller's rights.
privacyPolicy.rightsIntro: Where provided for by applicable legislation, data subjects may exercise the following rights:
privacyPolicy.rightAccess: right to access their personal data
privacyPolicy.rightRectification: right to rectify inaccurate or incomplete data
privacyPolicy.rightErasure: right to erasure of personal data
privacyPolicy.rightPortability: right to data portability, where applicable
privacyPolicy.rightObjection: right to object to processing where provided for
privacyPolicy.rightsText: To exercise these rights, users may contact the data controller using the contact details provided in this policy.
privacyPolicy.complaintText: Data subjects have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority if they believe that the processing of their personal data violates applicable legislation.
privacyPolicy.automatedText: The website does not use automated decision-making processes or profiling activities that produce legal effects or similarly significantly affect users.
privacyPolicy.changesText: This Privacy Policy may be updated following changes to the services, data processing activities or applicable legislation. The updated version will be published on this page.

general.title: 1. General information
general.text: These Terms and Conditions govern the use of the website and the purchase of products offered by Pistakio Gelato. By accessing and using the website and its services, users agree to these Terms and Conditions.

service.title: 2. Scope of the service
service.text: The website allows users to browse the product catalogue, create an account, place orders and choose among the delivery or collection options available. Pistakio Gelato reserves the right to modify, suspend or update the services offered.

account.title: 3. Account and registration
account.text: An account may be required to use certain website features. Users are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided and for keeping their login credentials confidential. Users agree not to use their account for unlawful or unauthorized purposes.

products.title: 4. Products and availability
products.text: Products are described in the online catalogue through text and images. Images are provided for illustrative purposes and may differ slightly from the actual product delivered. Product availability may change and Pistakio Gelato may modify or remove products from the catalogue.

orders.title: 5. Orders
orders.text: Orders are placed through the procedure available on the website. Submitting an order constitutes a purchase request from the user. The order is considered accepted when Pistakio Gelato confirms its acceptance. If a product is unavailable or other objective circumstances prevent fulfilment, Pistakio Gelato may reject or cancel the order, informing the user and issuing any applicable refund.

prices.title: 6. Prices
prices.text: Product prices are those displayed on the website at the time the order is placed. Any additional delivery or service costs are shown during the purchase process before the order is confirmed.

payment.title: 7. Payments
payment.text: Payments may be made using the methods available on the website, including Stripe and PayPal. Payment information is processed through the respective payment service providers according to their terms and privacy policies. Pistakio Gelato does not directly store complete payment card details.

delivery.title: 8. Delivery and collection
delivery.text: Available delivery and/or collection methods are displayed during the purchase process. Users are responsible for providing accurate delivery information. Delays caused by incorrect or incomplete information provided by the user are not attributable to Pistakio Gelato. For food and perishable products, customers must ensure that products can be received and stored appropriately.

withdrawal.title: 9. Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.text: Under applicable consumer protection legislation, the right of withdrawal may be excluded for certain products, including goods that are liable to deteriorate or expire rapidly. Due to the food and perishable nature of the products offered, the right of withdrawal may therefore not apply to purchases of gelato and other perishable products where permitted by law.

cancellation.title: 10. Cancellation and refunds
cancellation.text: Cancellation and refund requests are assessed according to the status of the order, the nature of the product and applicable law. If an order is cancelled by Pistakio Gelato after payment has been made, any amount due will be refunded through the payment method used, according to the procedures of the relevant payment provider.

liability.title: 11. Liability
liability.text: Pistakio Gelato endeavours to keep the website and services reasonably available, without guaranteeing that they will be completely uninterrupted or error-free. Users are responsible for the proper use of the website, their devices and their internet connection. Mandatory liabilities under applicable law remain unaffected.

intellectualProperty.title: 12. Intellectual property
intellectualProperty.text: The website, logo, texts, images, graphics and other content are protected by applicable law and belong to Pistakio Gelato or their respective owners. Reproduction or use of such content without the necessary authorization is prohibited.

privacy.title: 13. Privacy
privacy.text: The processing of users' personal data is governed by the Privacy Policy available on the website, which forms an integral part of the information concerning the use of the services.

cookies.title: 14. Cookies
cookies.text: The use of cookies and similar technologies is governed by the Cookie Policy available on the website.

changes.title: 15. Changes to the Terms
changes.text: Pistakio Gelato may update these Terms and Conditions to reflect legal, technical or service changes. The updated version will be published on the website together with the date of the latest update.

law.title: 16. Applicable law and disputes
law.text: These Terms and Conditions are governed by Italian law, without prejudice to mandatory provisions applicable to consumers. For disputes involving consumers, the applicable mandatory rules concerning jurisdiction will be respected.

contact.title: 17. Contact
contact.text: For information, order-related requests or communications concerning these Terms and Conditions, Pistakio Gelato can be contacted at:

general.title: 1. General information
general.text: This page describes the conditions applicable to returns, cancellations and the right of withdrawal for purchases made on the Pistakio Gelato website.

perishable.title: 2. Food and perishable products
perishable.text: The products offered by Pistakio Gelato are mainly food products, including gelato and other products that may deteriorate rapidly. For such products, the right of withdrawal may be excluded where provided for by applicable law.
perishable.noticeText: For gelato and other perishable food products, the right of withdrawal will normally not be available once the purchase has been made where the legal conditions for the exclusion apply.

withdrawal.title: 3. Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.text: For products for which the right of withdrawal applies, consumers generally have 14 days to communicate their decision to withdraw from the contract without providing a reason. For sales contracts, the period generally begins when the consumer takes physical possession of the goods, in accordance with applicable law.

nonPerishable.title: 4. Non-perishable products
nonPerishable.text: If Pistakio Gelato offers non-perishable products for which the right of withdrawal is not excluded by law, the right of withdrawal may be exercised within the terms and according to the procedures provided by applicable law.

howTo.title: 5. How to request withdrawal
howTo.text: Where the right of withdrawal applies, the consumer must communicate their decision before the applicable deadline expires. The notification may be made through an explicit declaration sent to Pistakio Gelato.

refund.title: 6. Refunds
refund.text: Where withdrawal applies and is validly exercised, Pistakio Gelato will refund the payments received within the deadlines required by law, using, unless otherwise agreed with the consumer, the same payment method used for the original transaction. The conditions and exceptions provided by applicable law remain applicable.

damaged.title: 7. Damaged, incorrect or non-conforming products
damaged.text: The right of withdrawal is distinct from consumer rights concerning defective, damaged, incorrect or non-conforming products. In such cases, customers are invited to contact Pistakio Gelato as soon as possible, providing the order number and, where possible, photographs of the product and packaging.

delivery.title: 8. Delivery issues
delivery.text: In case of delivery problems, such as a product damaged during transport, an incorrect product or a quantity that does not correspond to the order, the customer should contact Pistakio Gelato promptly so that the issue can be verified and the solution required by applicable law can be provided.
